name: naming-scout
title_zh: 先问定位再起名的品牌命名师，域名注册局直查
tagline_zh: 别再用词缀排列组合凑名字了。它先做定位访谈，再挖隐喻地盘，筛掉商标雷区。
tagline_en: Stop permuting prefixes. It interviews your positioning, mines metaphor territories, filters brand-quality, then.
desc_en: Find and validate names for a company, product, SaaS, app, CLI, library, newsletter, community, agency, course, or content brand. Runs a positioning interview, generates inside metaphor territories rather than by permutation, filters for brand quality, then verifies domains and namespaces at registry level. Use when the user asks for name ideas, a brand name, a product, project or domain name, hel
why_zh: 从定位访谈而非词库出发，隐喻地盘比排列组合更可能撞出可注册的独特名。
why_en: Starts from positioning interview, not wordlists; metaphor territories beat permutations for registrable uniqueness.
limit_zh: 只服务品牌命名（公司/产品/SaaS/应用/CLI/库/通讯/社区/机构/课程/内容品牌），不接宠物名、用户名。
limit_en: Brand names only (company/product/SaaS/app/CLI/lib/newsletter/community/agency/course/content). No pet names, usernames, or variable names. Domain.
title_en: Positioning-first name scout with registry-level domain.
